saw_lines: Fine jewelry gets bought as a keepsake, then worn, stacked, gifted or resized, so buyers want proof it fits and lasts.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, before a stranger trusts the piece enough to click.
Your 15 ads show no proof number, so a cold buyer has no reason to trust you. Pick one figure, such as review count, and lead three new ads with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 16 Oct 2026
points: None of your 15 ads shows a proof number, so a cold buyer has no reason to trust you over other jewelers. Pick one figure you already have, like review count or orders shipped. Lead three new ads with it.

0 of your 12 copy ads carry an offer, so a first-time buyer has no reason to act today. Put one first order offer, such as free delivery, in the opening line of three new ads. Aim it at cold audiences.

Your 12 copy ads open with 12 different stories, the biggest in only 1 ad, so a cold buyer never sees the same pitch twice. Build the next batch from two stories, the jewelry trade-in and the ring sizer quote.
Your ads use See details 5 times, Shop now 4 and Learn more 4, across 11 landing pages, so buyers get a different next step each time. Pick one CTA per product and link it to that product’s own page.

ads_1: Proof-led openers built on the ring sizer and the old jewelry trade-in
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Instagram and TikTok
